record.question: Why did the development of modern industry in colonial India tend to be more concentrated in areas such as Bombay and Calcutta?
options: They were completely free from any British commercial influence
They combined access to ports, railways, and existing commercial communities
They had lower colonial taxes compared to the rest of India
These cities were the only places allowed by law to establish factories
